summary: CI&T Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting its Annual General Meeting held on May 26, 2026. The meeting approved the company's financial statements for fiscal year 2025 and appointed Marcelo Dodsworth Penna as a director. No special situation event like an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any deal-related categorization.
